svg.title: Two full-time operators, two contract specialists
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-small-team-org; chart type: org_architecture; title: Two full-time operators, two contract specialists; subtitle: Illustrative base-team allocation; chapter number: 9; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values are role identifiers, not employee counts or pay. The owner and coordinator are full-time; research and counsel are contract roles.; caption: The owner manages case economics; the coordinator manages records and communication. Contract specialists retain responsibility for their assigned work.; stages: label: Owner / case lead; value: 1 FT; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Owns market selection, budgets, engagements and cash reconciliation; supervises coordinator and research deliverables.; label: Records / client coordinator; value: 1 FT; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Reports to owner; maintains custodian confirmations, deadline calendars and claimant document requests.; label: Title / records researcher; value: 1 C; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Delivers sourced title and docket packets to the case lead; flags contradictions without deciding disputed entitlement.; label: Independent counsel; value: 1 C; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Provides separately scoped professional review or representation; sales targets do not determine legal conclusions.
